description: This source file contains function implementations related to the DSL Home Model (DSLH) within the CcspCommonLibrary component, specifically for the MPR interface. It appears to be part of a larger system implementing TR-069 or similar management protocols, with licensing comments indicating use in firmware or embedded system software. The code includes a single function that verifies parameters under a device, currently stubbed to return a bad name status.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS DslhWmpdoMprRegObject_priv_CheckParameterUnderDevice(PDSLH_CWMP_OBJECT_DESCR pObjectDescr)
methods.description: Checks whether a given object descriptor's parameters are under a device. Currently stubbed to always return an error status indicating a bad name.
